_comment: Map from MCP servers and tools to what you really use them for and the lean path that replaces them. Copy to mcp-equivalents.json and edit. Keys are 'server' or 'server|tool' (server as it appears in tool-stats/tools.json, without the 'mcp · ' prefix); the most specific key wins. A library tool's own '# replaces:' header takes precedence. verdict: replaced (a library tool covers it), use-cli (an existing CLI already does it lean), fix-source (your own server; fix its output shape), keep (needs eyes, images or a domain server), retired (you no longer use it).

claude.ai Gmail.use: Mail writes: send, reply, drafts, labels.

memory.use: Your own memory server: recall and session listings.
memory.lean: trim the server's default result size
